locale_rationale: OH1988 is the concrete new reading benefit in 1.0.8. Ukrainian demand is a hypothesis, not established by device-language data in G01.
launch_gates: REV237 publication and OH1988 delivery verified for each advertised platform
owner permission for the specific listing updates and placements

channels.placement: One Ukrainian benefit section on the owner's Revelation website
channels.measurement: Partner Center page views and acquisitions with cid rev108-uk-site. Website visits and first reading remain unavailable without an approved measurement method.

channels.placement: Ukrainian Microsoft Store listing with the same one-minute example
channels.measurement: Store Acquisitions totals and internal Store source. Do not add campaign-attributed views to totals. Store does not prove that a verse was read.

decision_rules.continue: At D14, if 40 Store views and 3 installs are observed, entry points work and feedback shows no repeated reading blocker, retain the tested channel for one more bounded cycle. Small samples do not establish causation.
decision_rules.change: If views reach 40 but installs stay below 3, inspect listing-to-install friction. If installs occur but readers report a blocker, fix the reading path before increasing placements.
decision_rules.insufficient_data: With fewer than 40 views or missing/partial reporting, record insufficient evidence. Do not call missing data zero or claim a failed Ukrainian module.
decision_rules.stop: Stop the placement when its advertised module cannot be obtained or a reproducible reading blocker appears. Preserve evidence and do not replace the approved scope with new channels.

scheduling: No automation was created. D0/D7/D14 are relative checkpoints after an explicitly approved launch, not calendar appointments.
completed_dependencies: REV299 accepted by owner: complete OH1988 data 2
